article_notes: Romanian article (English translation used). 55 dogs with haemoparasitoses at a university emergency hospital: control (n=10, haemoparasitosis without IMHA, mild anaemia), group I (n=30, IMHA secondary to intracellular haemoparasites incl. B. canis, Anaplasma, Ehrlichia, Borrelia, Hepatozoon, Mycoplasma), group II (n=15, D. immitis). Only group I and group II summary haematology are printed; no control-group values and no test between groups (WBC in group II is said to be 'significantly higher' than control, without values or test, and is not Babesia). Mixed pathogens; B. canis dogs not reported separately. The statement that anaemia severity did not correlate with parasitaemia has no numbers or test.

not_extracted.note: Control-group values not printed and no test; mixed haemoparasites, B. canis not separated.
